validation_strategy: Deterministic Track-Based Group Split (GroupKFold by iceberg_id)
model_selection_rationale: Model V1 was trained on 65,775 samples across 12 complete tracks (covering 37 years, 1989-2026) and evaluated on 13,764 unseen test samples across 4 distinct iceberg tracks. Model V2 was evaluated on a small 157-sample 3-month window (Jan-Mar 2020), where small sample size prevents statistical generalization across all Antarctic sectors. Therefore, Model V1 is selected as the primary deployment model for global full-trajectory inference, while Model V2 is preserved for environmental proof-of-concept.
